process_steps.name: Assemble and apostille the Ukrainian documents (diploma, transcript with hours, study plan, subject programmes, professional habilitation) and have them officially translated into Spanish
Create a Cuenta Uchile using the passport as identity document
Pay the 2 UTM entry arancel in Chilean pesos from a Chilean bank account or by Banco Santander deposit, in the SAME calendar month as the application
process_steps.actor: Applicant or a third party resident in Chile

process_steps.name: Lodge the application in the Ucampus 'Revalidacion de titulo' module: three-step form, all documents as PDF, signed declaracion jurada, payment receipt attached
documents: All apostilled and translated documents as PDF
Ficha Declaracion de Solicitud firmada a mano

process_steps.name: Attend (or send an apoderado to) the cita to verify the ORIGINAL documents, then official registration - STATUS CONTESTED, may no longer exist
process_steps.actor: Applicant or a third party holding an apostilled poder notarial
documents: Original apostilled diploma, transcript, study plan and habilitacion
Poder notarial apostillado if a proxy attends

process_steps.name: Pay 3 UTM and undergo the curricular study at the Faculty of Medicine (70 to 80 per cent equivalence threshold)
process_steps.actor: Unidad de Revalida, Secretaria de Estudios, Facultad de Medicina

process_steps.name: Pay 15 UTM for cumplimiento de exigencias and be allocated a place in the monthly exam calendar
Sit the theory exam in person at sede Eloisa Diaz: five parts of 20 MCQ on EUNACOM content, 60 per cent pass, up to three attempts, monthly March to December
Sit the ECOE practical examinations in Medicina Interna, Pediatria, Ginecologia y Obstetricia and Cirugia, up to three attempts each, in Spanish
Prorrector resolves the revalidacion; Oficina de Titulos y Grados issues the diploma; the Registro Civil is notified for the Registro Publico de Profesionales

open_questions.question: Is the in-person cita to cotejar the original documents still required at Universidad de Chile after the 2026 rewrite of the Etapas page, and can an apoderado with an apostilled poder notarial still attend in the applicant's place?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This single point decides whether she can open and advance a file from Vinnytsia at all, or whether someone must physically carry the apostilled originals to Santiago. It also decides whether her son in Chile can act for her.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Write in Spanish to contactorevalidacion@uchile.cl and consultasrevalidacion@u.uchile.cl citing the two contradicting pages, and ask (a) whether a cita presencial is still part of the flow, (b) whether a tercero con poder notarial apostillado is accepted, (c) whether the originals must be physically in Santiago. Phone +569 31092434 Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 09:30-12:30 Chile time.

open_questions.question: Will the Oficina de Revalidacion accept a bank transfer whose reference carries a PASSPORT number instead of a RUT, and will it accept payment from a third party who is not the applicant?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The instructivo tells third-party payers to quote the applicant's RUT. She has no RUT. If a passport number is not accepted, every one of the three payments is blocked.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Same email and phone enquiry, asking for written confirmation of the reference format for a non-resident applicant.

open_questions.question: How does the Facultad de Medicina actually verify 'dominio razonable del idioma espanol', and is there a minimum level or certificate?
open_questions.why_it_matters: She is assumed to have no Spanish. If there is a formal test at entry, the whole route is blocked until she reaches a working level; if it is de facto tested only by the exams, she can start the paperwork while learning.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask serevalida.med@uchile.cl and eduardo.aguayo@uchile.cl directly, citing art. 6 inciso final of DU Exento N0030.203.

open_questions.question: What is the OBSERVED elapsed time from Ucampus lodgement to a revalidated titulo de Medico Cirujano at Universidad de Chile, as opposed to the published 'minimo 6 meses'?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The planning horizon for her whole move depends on it; the regulatory floor is almost certainly far below reality given monthly capped exam slots.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Oficina de Revalidacion for the median duration of Medicina files closed in 2025 and 2026, and request the 'Titulos Solicitados proceso de Revalidacion' dataset broken down by outcome. A Ley de Transparencia request via the 'Solicitud de informacion' link on uchile.cl is the fallback.

open_questions.question: Does Decreto Exento N384/2026 legally bind Universidad de Chile's revalidacion of a foreign PROFESSIONAL title, given that art. 1 of Decreto 174/2024 limits the reglamento's application to UChile to technical titles and convalidacion?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It determines whether the 2/3/15/20 UTM ceilings are a legal cap on UChile's medicina fees or merely a coincidence, and therefore whether UChile could raise the medicina fees unilaterally.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Read the full text of DFL 3/2006 art. 6 on bcn.cl/leychile, and check for any Contraloria dictamen after 17 Aug 2026 on the interaction. Lane L01 owns the legal reading.

open_questions.question: Is there a published 2026 examination calendar for the Medicina revalidacion, and how long is the current queue for a cupo?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 'Cupos limitados' with monthly sittings and a hard two-year completion clock means a long queue could itself cause a REPROBADO.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask eduardo.aguayo@uchile.cl for the 2026 and 2027 calendar and the typical wait between paying the 15 UTM and being given a date.

open_questions.question: Does the Faculty of Medicine ever require 'actividades curriculares adicionales' under art. 10 c) rather than only examinations for a foreign medical graduate, and at what additional cost?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Art. 10 c) lets the Faculty impose additional coursework priced by reference to a first-year Medicina arancel, and DEX 384 allows up to 20 UTM for this. That would add a year and a large sum that none of the published medicina material mentions.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Faculty whether art. 10 c) has ever been applied to a Medicina revalidante and what it cost.

unknowns_declared: The language of the Medicina revalidacion examinations is NOT stated on any page found. Spanish is overwhelmingly likely (sat in person in Santiago, and the reglamento requires Spanish proficiency) but it is an inference, not a sourced fact.

No official OBSERVED duration for a Medicina revalidacion was found. The only sourced number is the university's own 'duracion minima de 6 meses'. Any total-duration figure elsewhere in this project should be labelled an estimate.

No published pass rate, application count or approval count specific to Medicina revalidacion was found. The 'Titulos Solicitados proceso de Revalidacion' PDF was identified on the Cifras page but was not opened or cross-tabulated by country or outcome.
Whether the in-person cita still exists is genuinely unresolved (L02-C06). Three live official surfaces disagree with each other today.

It is unknown whether a Chilean bank account is needed for the later 3 UTM and 15 UTM payments too. The 'pesos chilenos desde una cuenta chilena' rule is stated only for the 2 UTM entry fee; the Faculty page lists 'transferencia electronica, caja del Banco de Chile, o tarjeta de credito' for the other two, which might admit a foreign credit card - not verified.

It is unknown whether the Oficina de Revalidacion will accept a Ukrainian equivalent of 'habilitacion profesional', or what document Ukraine issues that satisfies art. 6 f). Lane L08 owns the Ukrainian document chain.
Decreto Exento N384/2026 was read from a scanned image with no text layer. The quoted articles were transcribed visually; the substance is certain but character-level fidelity is not guaranteed.

The Facultad de Medicina revalidacion PDF is dated only by its file metadata (11 Aug 2025) and the linking web page carries no date at all, so the exam design and fees could have changed in the year since.

No evidence was found either way on whether Universidad de Chile changed anything operationally because of Decreto 174/2024 entering into force on 17 August 2026, beyond swapping the attached regulations on the Etapas page and deleting the cita bullets.

The correct postal address of the Oficina de Revalidacion is uncertain: uchile.cl publishes Portugal 84, Torre 15, oficina 302 while the live booking site publishes Diagonal Paraguay 265, oficina 302.

No information was found on whether the Facultad de Medicina gives any weight to a foreign specialty (rheumatology) or postgraduate degree during the curricular study; the published exam design is entirely general-practice.
